result: If I had the power to change the world in one way, I would focus on improving universal access to quality education. Education is a fundamental right, and it has the power to upturn poverty, foster gender equality, increase understanding and tolerance, and promote peace. I would ensure that every single child, regardless of their geographical location, financial status, or societal background, has an equal opportunity to receive quality education and grow to their fullest potential. By prioritizing education, we can build a more informed, empathetic, and knowledgeable global society.
